watchOut: TAFS reviews and contracts now lead to eCapital.
owner: eCapital; tafs.com now redirects to ecapital.com
name: eCapital (includes TAFS)
summary: Large commercial finance group whose freight factoring now also covers the former TAFS brand.
differentiator: If you are comparing TAFS and eCapital, they are now one company: tafs.com redirects to ecapital.com. eCapital publishes up to 100% advances and funding in as little as an hour, but no rate.

terms.advance: Up to 100% (eCapital says the industry usually advances 80-90%)
terms.contract: You are not required to sign long-term contracts
terms.speed: Funded in as fast as 1 hour
terms.fuel: Fuel program with $2,500 in pre-approved credit, also available without factoring
